brief: A herb planter of three cells side by side, each with a bin that drains.

requirements.requirement: Build has three cells side by side on a single level
requirements.evidence: piece:0,0,0;full, piece:1,0,0;full, piece:2,0,0;full in row q=0..2 level 0

requirements.requirement: Each of the three cells contains a bin that drains (drained/drainage holes)
Each bin is prepared as a planter with soil
requirements.evidence: soil filled in all three bins via fill_and_plant

requirements.requirement: Herb plants are planted in each bin to show use as herb planter
requirements.evidence: prop:1 basil-young, prop:2 mint-young, prop:3 parsley-young planted in soil

finish.summary: Three full hex bases side by side with a drained full-depth bin in each, all filled with soil and planted with herbs (basil, mint, parsley). Open faces capped and joints locked.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
